name: Layla AI - In & Out Laundry Customer Service V1

parameters.content:
## Layla AI - Customer Service Agent

وكيل خدمة عملاء واتساب لمغسلة In & Out Laundry.

Webhook URL after activation:
https://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/layla-ai-customer-service

Required n8n Variables:
- OPENAI_API_KEY
- LAYLA_OPENAI_MODEL
- TEXTCONNECT_SECRET
- TEXTCONNECT_ACCOUNT

Recommended Variables:
- LAYLA_SITE_URL=https://www.inandoutuae.com
- LAYLA_ESCALATION_WHATSAPP=9715xxxxxxx
- TEXTCONNECT_INCOMING_SECRET

Optional protected API access:
- LAYLA_APP_BEARER_TOKEN

Capabilities:
- Booking guidance
- Order tracking link / protected status lookup when token exists
- Pricing and branch questions
- Complaint intake
- Human escalation alert
- Arabic / English replies
